query: What are the MTech specializations offered at DUK?
gold_answer:
The M.Tech. programmes offered at Digital University Kerala (DUK) are categorized into two main areas, each with specific specializations approved by AICTE:
1. M.Tech. Computer Science and Engineering
This program is offered by the School of Computer Science and Engineering (SoCSE) and includes the following three specializations:
• Artificial Intelligence
• Connected Systems and Intelligence
• Cybersecurity Engineering
2. M.Tech. Electronics Engineering
This program is offered by the School of Electronic Systems and Automation (SoESA) and includes the following three specializations:
• AI Hardware
• IoT & Robotics
• VLSI Design

query: What is the eligibility requirement for MBA admission?
gold_answer:
The eligibility requirements for admission to the Master of Business Administration (MBA) program at Digital University Kerala (DUK) are generally determined by academic qualifications, minimum marks, and required entrance examination scores.
General Requirements
1. Academic Degree: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree. The general eligibility for master's programs requires a 3-year or 4-year graduation in the relevant stream(s) fixed by the School.
2. Minimum Marks: A minimum aggregate of 60% marks in the Bachelor's degree (qualifying degree) is required. This is equivalent to a CGPA of 6.5 or higher on a 10-point scale.
◦ Marks will not be rounded to meet the minimum criteria.
◦ If an applicant's CGPA is below 6.5, they may still be eligible if their university's conversion criteria translate the CGPA to 60% or higher. In such cases, the candidate must provide an official document detailing the conversion methodology at the time of admission.
3. Entrance Examination Score: Candidates must possess a valid entrance examination score approved by the University. The approved national-level entrance exams for MBA admission are:
◦ CUET(PG)
◦ CAT
◦ CMAT
◦ KMAT
◦ XAT
◦ NMAT/GMAT
◦ GRE
◦ DUAT (Digital University Admission Test)
Applicants who qualify through these exams will be shortlisted for a group discussion and an interview.
Special Eligibility Conditions
Relaxation for Reserved Categories:
• SC/ST/PwD candidates: Eligible if they have secured the minimum passing marks.
• SEBC-NCL candidates of Kerala: Eligible for 5% relaxation.
Final Year Students:
1. Must appear for all final exams for the first time.
2. Must have passed all previous years.
MBA for Working Professionals: Requires a minimum of 2 years relevant industry experience in addition to other requirements.

query: What is Digital University Aptitude Test and how is it conducted?
gold_answer:
The Digital University Aptitude Test (DUAT) is an entrance examination administered by Digital University Kerala (DUK) for the selection of candidates for various postgraduate programs.
Purpose and Scope:
• It is a valid entrance score for MBA.
• Required for M.Sc. programs.
• Conducted twice a year.
• Students with national-level exam scores (CUET(PG), CAT, GATE, etc.) may be exempt.
• Cut-off score decided by each School.
• Application fees: ₹750 for General, ₹375 for SC/ST/Divyang.
DUAT Test Codes:
• DUAT01: MBA
• DUAT02: M.Sc. Computer Science specializations
• DUAT03: M.Sc. Electronics and Applied Physics
• DUAT04: M.Sc. Ecology/Environmental Science
• DUAT05: M.Sc. Data Science and Bio-AI
• DUAT06: M.Sc. Data Science and Geoinformatics
How DUAT is Conducted:
1. Mode: Online
2. Monitoring: AI + human proctoring
3. Requirements: Laptop/desktop with webcam and stable internet
4. Structure: 60 MCQs
5. Duration: 60 minutes
6. Marking: +1 for correct, –0.25 for incorrect

query: What is the application fee for Digital University AT?
gold_answer:
The application fee for candidates appearing for the Digital University Admission Test (DUAT) is:
• General category: ₹750
• SC/ST/Divyang candidates: ₹375
The application fee is non-refundable.

query: Is hostel accommodation available for male students?
gold_answer:
On-campus hostel accommodation at Digital University Kerala is currently available only for female students.
Key points:
• Twin occupancy hostel facilities are provided on campus for female students.
• The six-storey hostel structure has 100+ rooms accommodating 200+ female students.
• Male students and others without hostel allotment will be assisted by DUK in finding suitable off-campus accommodation options.

query: What is the Earn While You Learn scheme?
gold_answer:
The Earn While You Learn scheme is a financial aid program offered by Digital University Kerala (DUK) that provides selected students with paid internships.
How it works:
• Students are placed in R&D projects where DUK collaborates with government, industry, and research organizations.
• The number of positions depends on availability of funds.
• Students receive payment for their work on these projects.

query: Explain the Digital University Aptitude Test syllabus and marking scheme for MSc and MTech programmes.
gold_answer:
The Digital University Aptitude Test (DUAT) is required for M.Sc. programs but is not the designated admission test for M.Tech.
General DUAT Structure:
• Mode: Online
• Duration: 60 minutes
• Questions: 60 MCQs
• Monitoring: AI + human invigilator
• Technical Requirements: Laptop/desktop with webcam and stable internet
• Marking: +1 correct, –0.25 incorrect
M.Sc. DUAT Syllabus:
DUAT02—M.Sc. CS/Data Analytics/Cybersecurity/AI:
• General Aptitude (20 marks)
• Mathematics (20 marks)
• Computer Basics (20 marks)
DUAT03—M.Sc. Electronics / Applied Physics:
• General Aptitude (20)
• Mathematics (10)
• Physics/Electronics/Devices/Circuits (30)
DUAT04—M.Sc. Ecology / Environmental Science:
• General Aptitude (20)
• Elementary Math & Computers (10)
• UG-level Chemistry/Physics/Biology/Ecology (30)
DUAT05—M.Sc. Data Science and Bio-AI:
• General Aptitude (20)
• Mathematics (10)
• Biochemistry/Biotech/Chemistry (20)
• Computer Basics (10)
DUAT06—M.Sc. Data Science and Geoinformatics:
• General Aptitude (20)
• Mathematics (10)
• Earth & Environmental Sciences (20)
• Remote sensing & GIS (10)
• Computer Basics (10)

query: Compare the focus areas of School of Digital Sciences and School of Digital Humanities.
gold_answer:
The School of Digital Sciences (SoDS) and the School of Digital Humanities and Liberal Arts (SoDiHLA) at Digital University Kerala have different disciplinary orientations.
School of Digital Sciences (SoDS):
• Focus: Quantitative analysis, computational methods, data-driven applications.
• Programs: M.Sc. Data Analytics, M.Sc. Computer Science (Data Analytics/A.I./Cybersecurity), M.Sc. Data Science & Bio-AI, M.Sc. Data Science & Geoinformatics.
• Themes: Computing and Intelligence.
School of Digital Humanities and Liberal Arts (SoDiHLA):
• Focus: Managerial, organizational, and societal applications of digital technologies.
• Programs: MBA with specializations such as Digital Governance, Digital Transformation, Information Security Management, Business Analytics, etc.
Summary:
• SoDS → Technical, data-oriented, computational.
• SoDiHLA → Managerial, governance, strategy-focused applications.

query: Explain the steps to apply for DUK scholarships and financial aid.
gold_answer:
The process for applying for scholarships and financial aid at DUK depends on the type of scheme.
1. Central and State Government Scholarships:
Students must apply via external portals:
• E-Grantz (SC/ST/OEC students of Kerala): https://egrantz.kerala.gov.in/
• Fisheries Scholarship (children of fishermen): http://www.egrantzfisheries.kerala.gov.in/
• AICTE PG Scholarship for GATE-qualified M.Tech students: https://www.aicte-india.org/
• Other national/state schemes: scholarships.gov.in, minoritywelfare.kerala.gov.in, dcescholarship.kerala.gov.in, kswcfc.org
2. University-provided Financial Aid:
A. Earn While You Learn:
• Paid internships in R&D projects.
• Dependent on availability of funds.
B. DUK Ph.D. Scholarships:
• For full-time regular Ph.D. scholars without external fellowships.
• ₹20,000/month (Year 1), ₹25,000 (Year 2), ₹30,000 (Year 3).
• Recipients must contribute 10 hours/week to university academic activities.
External JRF holders receive their respective fellowships.

query: Summarize DUK’s vision, mission, and core values.
gold_answer:
Vision:
To be a globally respected hub of digital education and research, developing futuristic talents who create innovative and sustainable digital solutions for industry, government, and society.
Mission:
To "curate a responsible digital world" by advancing digital technologies for social good and promoting excellence in disruptive technologies.
Core Values (Themes of Action):
1. Computing
2. Intelligence
3. Sustainability
4. Entrepreneurship
Computing and Intelligence are the primary focus areas, while Sustainability and Entrepreneurship act as guiding principles.
